summary: Nez Perce NF log tower site in Idaho County: a 1930s 10-foot structure never completed, listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 10-foot log tower with log walls (hewn logs, dovetailed); never completed
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists type Tower, status Gone; Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe a structure never finished and abandoned

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in; no trail or access details given

events.note: Log tower with log walls dates to the 1930s (sources give the decade only); never completed

evidence.supports: 1930s 10-foot log tower with log walls, never completed, abandoned
evidence.quote: 1930s: 10' log tower, log walls. Never completed. Abandoned.

evidence.supports: about 16 miles east-southeast of the Red River Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 16 miles ESE of Red River R.S.

corrections.why: Firelookout.com gives the county as Idaho County, Idaho; 'Idaho' is the state name

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the status as Gone, while the Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe a log tower that was never finished and then abandoned. We keep gone as the listing status; no source says what remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Four sources, all short. Dating (1930s) and never-finished/abandoned status agree across sources 1-3. Nothing found on staffing, fires or access. Firelookout.com credits a photo to the U.S. Forest Service but gives no image URL, so no photos entry. Not NHLR-registered per the FFLA listing. Record county 'Idaho' corrected to 'Idaho County'.
